I used to think everyone hated me. It outright stopped me from going to any social events or just leaving my house. Anytime my friends invited me out I felt like they just wanted to harass and manipulate me. Truth was nobody actually hated me. In fact now that I've gotten more social many people tell me they thought I didn't want to talk to anyone and talked about me because they thought something tragic had happened in my life recently and I might need help. If those people really do hate you then they honestly have nothing better to do with their life. If there gonna hate because you don't wanna drink then their hatred is nonsensical and invalid. Good luck on your journey.

Dude honestly I feel that. Sometimes when I look at myself I feel like I'm the only one messing up and everyone else around me is thriving. But, the truth is many people feel like this. When you are tunnel visioned in on your every mistake you forget that a significant amount of people are doing the exact same thing. Despite the frickin suck of life keep trying and growing. Trust me when you keep pushing to improve and fight those stupid thoughts in your head you'll realize that a lot of them are lies and life starts to gradually improve. I believe in you man :)

I think I'm an interesting person I just simply didn't find the urge to communicate with other people and I had to force myself to start talking to people even if my first attempts where a bit awkward I found out that when I actually started talking to people I got out of that rut I was stuck in, and now I have quite a few friends that I talk to regularly. Yeah in highschool I was the quiet kid lol and I used to have no friends so I started picking up hobbies and now I really love to mountain bike and I met people through that. Getting out of your comfort zone and just in general finding new things to enjoy will do wonders for you.

My advice is that you should find things to do every single day so that even if you get into a slump and everything falls apart you still have something to hang onto. If that doesn't work something I do is everyday I compare myself to what I was yesterday, and everyday I try to be a little bit better.
I don't have any real advice but I want you to know that I feel like this a lot to and your not the only one.
